dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you look like you're up to something...?

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: I just guard the door. I know nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Sturdy Wu
dialogues.text: Even if I did occasionally overhear business secrets, there's no way I'd go leaking information to people. Don't go spreading baseless rumors...
